interface.shortDescription: Protein research over UniProtKB — search by function, fetch curated records, map IDs, proteomes.
interface.longDescription: The protein-as-primary-entity research workflow over UniProt. Search UniProtKB by function, keyword, GO term, gene, or organism; retrieve full curated Swiss-Prot entries (function, catalytic activity, subcellular location, disease, PTMs, isoforms, sequence, cross-references); map identifiers across 100+ databases via the async ID-mapping service; and pull reference proteomes and taxonomy. Keyless, CC BY 4.0.
